description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Mohamed Abubucker Sadureen as a member of the Puttalam Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Puttalam Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a local government position, including the resignation of a member, the nomination of a replacement by a political party, and the official declaration of the new elected member by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters for local authorities.
